data.name: AnyNegativeBalance
data.value: Any negative balance for a given month will be carried forward to the next. For example if for the month of January your affiliate account ends with -$2,555, this amount will be carried forward to February. If at the end of February your affiliate account earns $3,400, the total balance will be $845 ($3,400 deduct -$2,555). However if your account is still making a loss at the end of February, for example -$1,600, then it will be added to the previous negative balance and be carried forward to March resulting in your March balance brought forward to be -$4,155. data.name: HowDoesTheSystem
data.value: How does the system keep track of my players?

data.name: WeEmploys
data.value: We employs state-of-the-art technology in our tracking system to ensure you receive credit for 100% of the traffic you send spondemo.com. Affiliates refer players by using their unique URL that is provided in the Media Gallery area. Through the use of cookies, visitors that click through an affiliate unique URL (banner, text link, email message etc) are tracked and credit is automatically given to the affiliate for players referred.

data.name: WillYouTrackAndGiveMeCredit
data.value: Will you track and give me credit for non-members that did not sign up on the first visit through my affiliate link but return to spondemo.com later and become a member?

data.name: WeAreAbleToTrackVisitors
data.value: Yes. We are able to track visitors from our affiliate's website that don't sign up right away but, return to spondemo.com at a later date & sign-up. We set our protection period for 90 days to cover the first referring affiliate. The technology used to manage this is based on cookies.

data.name: CookiesAreAGeneralMechanism
data.value: Cookies are a general mechanism which server-side connections can use to both store and retrieve information on the client side of the connection. More specifically, they are small data files placed on the computers of visitors to spondemo.com from affiliated websites. These data files contain information spondemo.com use to track and credit its affiliates accurately for the traffic they send. Tracking via cookies can include, but is not limited to, lists of pages visited as well as date and time when certain pages were looked at.

The appearance and syntax of the hypertext transfer links are designed and designated by us and constitute the only authorized and permitted representation of Affiliate.

data.name: Youwillnotknowingly
data.value: 8. You will not knowingly benefit from known or suspected traffic not generated in good faith whether or not it actually causes Affiliate damage. Should fraudulent activity arise through a person directed to a site via your link, we retain the right to retract the commissions paid to you at any time. Our decision in this regard will be final and no correspondence will be entered into. data.name: Affiliatesareprohibited

This shall include any individuals or playing groups from which an Affiliate receives compensation or remuneration from of any kind. In the event of violation of this section, Affiliate and the respective website that has been played with shall have the right to void all play and eliminate any earned commissions applicable from such play and eliminate the affiliate from our Affiliate Program terminating this Agreement and void any future play at Affiliate.

data.name: YouAreNotAllowed
data.value: 10. You are not allowed to concurrently maintain both affiliate and referral relationships with Affiliate. Violation of this provision grants Affiliate the right to unilaterally terminate either or both affiliate and/or referral relationships. A referral relationship refers to a relationship with Affiliate pursuant to Affiliate’s Refer-A-Friend Program (as setout and available in the Website).

data.name: Youareonlyresponsible
data.value: 1. You are only responsible for directing customers to the Affiliate website.

data.name: Onlyproperlytaggedcustomers
data.value: 2. Only properly tagged customers can be assigned to an affiliate. Should an affiliate tag be improperly inserted into the affiliate site or not properly received by the Affiliate web server the resulting customer registration and purchases will not be assigned to the affiliate. Therefore it is the responsibility of the affiliate to ensure that all links are properly tagged.

data.name: OneTwoBETwillpayout
data.value: 1. Affiliate will pay out a revenue share on the Commissionable Earnings generated by each customer, as defined by Affiliate Affiliate Program commission structure, provided that you maintain in your account as an affiliate, at least five (5) Active Wagering Members in any given calendar month.

data.name: ActiveWageringMembersRefers
data.value: 2. Active Wagering Members refers to customers that reach a minimum wagering turnover amount equivalent to One Hundred Dollars (USD100.00) each in any given calendar month.

data.name: CommissionableEarningsAreCalculated
data.value: 3. Commissionable Earnings are calculated as Affiliate Gross Win, less the following:

data.name: Chargeback
data.value:
a. Charge-backs;
b. Bonuses;
c. Uncollectable revenue, including transactions that are reversed by us or on our behalf;
d. Processing charges;
e. Monies attributed to fraud;
f. Sums paid to the concerned customer to resolve a dispute; and
g. Any other un-collectable revenue or deductions that Affiliate is entitled to collect under its Standard Terms and Conditions.

data.name: Shouldtheplayer
data.value: b. Should the player process a charge back, the disputed or charged-back revenue generated by yourself will be forfeited and therefore deducted from the total balance due to you for the current month.

data.name: Shouldthisdeduction
data.value: c. Should this deduction of the accumulated revenue exceed your current amount due, your balance will then revert to a negative balance, and you will have to earn revenue to cover the charge-back before you can start earning revenue again.

data.name: Unlikewithaplayer
data.value: d. Unlike with a player making a big winning, which only lasts one month, a charge back will stay due untill the revenue generated by your other players has covered the amount due.

data.name: Weunderstandthat
data.value: e. We understand that this might be frustrating to the affiliates, but it has to be made clear that Affiliate can only pay out a percentage of their profits, not fraudulent revenue.

data.name: ComplimentaryMoney
data.value: f. Complimentary Money, Free Money and Other incentives refer to those amounts credited to the account of customers. As they have not purchased these amounts Affiliate cannot pay commissions on these amounts.

data.name: ShouldYouFailToBe
data.value: 4. Should you fail to be entitled to the Commissionable Earnings in accordance with Clauses 4.1, 4.2, and 4.3 above for failure to maintain at least five (5) Active Wagering Members in a given month, you may be given (at Affiliate’s sole discretion) a grace period of two (2) months within which to comply. Upon compliance, your commission for the subject period not exceeding three (3) consecutive months will be consolidated to constitute your Commissionable Earnings for the same period. (at Affiliate’s sole discretion)

data.name: Commissionableearnings

data.value:
“Affiliate Gross Win” is the total of all amounts bet by at least five (5) Active Wagering Members under your affiliate account in a calendar month, minus all amounts won by or paid to your Active Wagering Members.

“Charge-backs” are amounts deducted when a customer that is a credit card holder discovers irregular unauthorized charge-backs made on the customer’s Credit/Debit Card, and the credit card holder requests the bank to reverse these charges. Charge-backs may relate to, but are not limited to, fraudulent use by a third party of the credit card holder's card or card number.

Should the player process a charge back, the disputed or charged-back revenue will be forfeited and therefore deducted from the total balance due to you for the current month. Should this deduction of the accumulated revenue exceed your current amount due, your balance will then revert to a negative balance, and you will have to earn revenue to cover the charge-back before you can start earning revenue again.

A charge back will stay due until the revenue generated by your other players has covered the amount due. You acknowledge that Affiliate can only pay out a percentage of their actual profits, not fraudulent revenue.

“Bonuses” include complimentary money, free money offers, credits, sign-up bonuses, promotional amounts and other incentives credited to the account of customers. As customers have not actually purchased these amounts, Affiliate cannot pay commissions on the same.
